newsitem.title: EGYPT: UAE president to visit Egypt within days.
newsitem.headline: UAE president to visit Egypt within days.

text.p: Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan, president of the United Arab Emirates, will visit Egypt within the next three days for talks with President Hosni Mubarak, diplomatic sources said on Wednesday.
Mubarak and Sheikh Zaid last met in Geneva in early July, shortly after an Arab summit in Cairo.
The UAE president usually visits Egypt for a few days in the late summer. He spends most of his time in the Mediterranean city of Alexandria, which is cooler and breezier than Cairo.
